name: old-lock-server-default
cmd: bun -e 'import {protocols} from "./research/protocols/ic3syn/models.ts"; import {proveSetFast,proveLaws} from "./kernel/prove.ts"; import {checkLaws} from "./kernel/kernel.ts"; const p=protocols.find(x=>x.id==="lock_server"); const a=p.make(); const first=proveSetFast(a.machine,a.kindLaws()); const b=p.make(),ls=b.kindLaws(); const fast=proveSetFast(b.machine,ls); const ordinary=proveLaws(b.machine,ls); console.log(JSON.stringify({id:p.id,scope:"only kind laws on two fresh constructions, not canonical safety run",alpha:process.env.GDP_MEMO_ALPHA??"default",first:{proven:first.proven,checked:first.checked},fast:{proven:fast.proven,checked:fast.checked,failed:fast.failed},ordinary:{proven:ordinary.proven,checked:ordinary.checked,rechecked:!!ordinary.proof&&checkLaws(b.machine,ls,ordinary.proof)}},null,2));' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/repro.json"
